before: Type the whole of `TOOLKIT_ARC-0020.md` (only what changes: 9 Stats entries, the lists, the progression and one goal),
Console edition (Script Extender off) unless a test says PC edition.
A new Veilwalker (Arcana, subclass The Veilwalker) at level 1, levelled up only after the level's tests pass. Keep a save
Values come from `25` (`*_Deceiver_*`): Splinter 1d6 Psychic in 3 m (4 m at Tier III), Doubt −1 per stack, Deluded at the
*Mirrored Self* from a Double (DV25) is not in this build (SPEC_ARC-0020, Deferred): level 10 tests it as it is today.

sessions.name: Level 1 — The Veil: Doubles on the field, Doubt on enemies
sessions.setup: A new Veilwalker at level 1 in a fight with three or more enemies (goblins work), one ally in the party.

tests.expected: Passives: The Veil only (no Telepathy, no Doubt). Spells: Malicious Whispers, Eidolon, Friends. No Seed of Doubt, no Faceless
tests.fails: Telepathy or Doubt is listed, or Seed of Doubt / Faceless is already there
tests.steps: Open the character sheet and the spellbook at level 1
tests.title: The level-1 kit is the map of DV35

tests.expected: "Every lie an enemy believes plants Doubt in it. At the third, it becomes Deluded", the Doubles explained, and "4 from level 8 and 5 from level 12"
tests.fails: The text is missing, names Sigil or Shatter, or says level 7
tests.steps: Hover The Veil on the character sheet
tests.title: The Veil states the one rule

tests.expected: One Double appears with her look and the Duplicity shimmer, 1 hit point
tests.fails: No Double, more than one, or a Double with more than 1 hit point
tests.steps: Cast Eidolon on a spot within 9 m
tests.title: Eidolon summons one Double that looks like her

tests.expected: AC rises by 1 (Veil layer status on her)
tests.fails: AC doesn't change
tests.steps: Note her AC with no Double, then with one Double on the field
tests.title: Each Double gives her +1 AC

tests.expected: Movement, Dash, Disengage, Splinter, Dismiss; no weapon attack, no bonus action, no reaction
tests.fails: It can attack, or Reflected Seed / Unveil are already there
tests.steps: On the Double's turn, open its hotbar
tests.title: A Double has its own turn with Splinter and Dismiss only

tests.expected: Each enemy within 3 m takes 1d6 Psychic and gains 1 Doubt; the Double is gone
tests.fails: No damage, no Doubt, or the Double stays
tests.steps: Walk the Double next to two enemies and cast Splinter
tests.title: A Splinter bursts around the Double

tests.expected: That enemy gains 1 Doubt
tests.fails: No Doubt on the destroyer
tests.steps: Leave a Double next to an enemy and end the turn; let the enemy destroy it
tests.title: An enemy that destroys a Double gains Doubt

tests.expected: It becomes Deluded (Confused, 1 turn) and its Doubt stacks reset
tests.fails: No Deluded, or the stacks stay
tests.steps: Bring one enemy to 3 Doubt (Splinters, a Double it destroys)
tests.title: The third Doubt makes an enemy Deluded

tests.expected: The status reads −1 per stack to Wisdom Saving Throws and to Attack Rolls against her and her Doubles; the roll shows −2
tests.fails: No penalty shown or applied
tests.steps: Hover an enemy with 2 Doubt; let it attack her or a Double
tests.title: Doubt lowers its Wisdom saves and its attacks against her

tests.expected: The Double goes; no damage and no Doubt to anyone
tests.fails: It bursts or someone gains Doubt
tests.steps: Put a Double next to an enemy and cast its Dismiss
tests.title: Dismiss: no Splinter, no Doubt

tests.expected: No one gains Doubt
tests.fails: The ally or an enemy gains Doubt
tests.steps: Let an ally destroy one of her Doubles (an area spell, or an attack)
tests.title: An ally's hit on a Double plants no Doubt

tests.expected: Wisdom save; on a failure Psychic damage and Disadvantage on its next attack; no Doubt (it carries no Seed)
tests.fails: No save, no Disadvantage, or Doubt without a Seed
tests.steps: Cast Malicious Whispers on an enemy without a Seed
tests.title: Malicious Whispers: the fallback turn

tests.expected: The Double is gone and her AC is back to normal
tests.fails: A Double stays after combat, or the AC bonus stays
tests.steps: End a fight with a Double on the field
tests.title: Doubles vanish when combat ends

tests.expected: The check has Advantage
tests.fails: No Advantage
tests.steps: Cast Friends on a non-hostile creature and start a dialogue with a Charisma check
tests.title: Friends gives Advantage on Charisma checks

sessions.name: Level 2 — Seed of Doubt: a lie that bursts later
sessions.setup: Level up to 2. A fight with three or more enemies.

tests.expected: Seed of Doubt and Faceless are new at level 2
tests.fails: Either is missing, or something else arrives
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen and the spellbook
tests.title: Level 2 grants Seed of Doubt and Faceless

tests.expected: Force damage with no roll to hit, and a Seed on it for 6 turns
tests.fails: It can miss, or no Seed status
tests.steps: Cast Seed of Doubt on an enemy
tests.title: Seed of Doubt never misses and plants a Seed

tests.expected: The Seed bursts: Psychic damage and 1 Doubt; the Seed is gone
tests.fails: The Seed stays, or no Doubt
tests.steps: Hit the Seeded enemy with Malicious Whispers (fails its save)
tests.title: Her next Arcane damage bursts the Seed

tests.expected: The Splinter's damage and Doubt land; the Seed stays
tests.fails: The Seed bursts
tests.rule: DESIGN §4.4 (a Splinter is not her Arcane spell)
tests.steps: Splinter a Double next to a Seeded enemy
tests.title: A Splinter does not burst a Seed

tests.expected: Paranoia (no reactions) and 2 Doubt in total: the rider's and the Seed's burst
tests.fails: No Paranoia, or only 1 Doubt
tests.steps: Seed an enemy, then cast Malicious Whispers on it (it fails)
tests.title: Malicious Whispers on a Seeded target: Paranoia and its own Doubt

tests.expected: She takes its appearance
tests.fails: Nothing changes
tests.steps: Out of combat, cast Faceless on a humanoid
tests.title: Faceless takes another face

sessions.name: Level 3 — Tier I: Doubt pays
sessions.setup: Level up to 3. A fight with four or more enemies.

tests.expected: Veiled Prison and *2 - The High Priestess: Awakening* are new; Binding Falsehood is not there yet
tests.fails: Binding Falsehood is already granted, or Veiled Prison is missing
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen and the spellbook
tests.title: Level 3 grants Veiled Prison and the Awakening, not Binding Falsehood

tests.expected: It counts down from 4; at the fourth stack *Veiled* (Tier I) wakes
tests.fails: The count doesn't move, or the tier wakes at another number
tests.steps: Apply Doubt in a fight and watch the progress status
tests.title: The Awakening counts Doubt: 4 stacks wake Tier I

tests.expected: Both attacks roll with Disadvantage; an enemy without Doubt rolls normally
tests.fails: No Disadvantage, or Disadvantage without Doubt
tests.steps: At Tier I, let an enemy with Doubt attack her, then a Double
tests.title: Veiled: doubting enemies attack her and her Doubles with Disadvantage

tests.expected: Every Double Splinters, every Seed of hers bursts, and each surviving enemy with Doubt becomes Deluded
tests.fails: A Double stays, a Seed stays, or an enemy with Doubt is not Deluded
tests.planb: Explode at each Double's position from Osiris
tests.steps: At Tier I, with two Doubles near enemies and one Seeded enemy, cast The Veil Lifts
tests.title: The Veil Lifts: every lie bursts at once

tests.expected: 1 Doubt: a normal save. 2 Doubt: the save has Disadvantage
tests.fails: Disadvantage at 1, or none at 2
tests.steps: Cast Veiled Prison on an enemy with 1 Doubt, then (another fight or rest) on one with 2
tests.title: Veiled Prison: Disadvantage on the save at 2 Doubt, not at 1

tests.expected: It can't move, act or react; the hit is a Critical Hit
tests.fails: It acts, or the hit is not critical
tests.steps: Let a Veiled Prison land; attack the target from within 3 m
tests.title: Veiled Prison: Incapacitated, critical hits from 3 m

sessions.name: Level 4 — Splinter on Command: spend a body when she chooses
sessions.setup: Level up to 4 (take the feat). A fight with three or more enemies.

tests.expected: Splinter on Command is new: a Bonus Action, no spell slot
tests.fails: Missing, it costs a slot, or it is an Action
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen and the hotbar
tests.title: Level 4 grants Splinter on Command

tests.expected: Only the Double can be targeted, within 18 m
tests.fails: An enemy or an ally can be targeted
tests.steps: Open Splinter on Command and hover an enemy, an ally, then one of her Doubles
tests.title: It targets only her Doubles

tests.expected: The Double bursts at once: 1d6 Psychic and 1 Doubt to each enemy within 3 m; the Double is gone; her Bonus Action is spent
tests.fails: Nothing happens, it waits for the Double's turn, or it fails because the Double already acted
tests.planb: Make Splinter on Command a ground-targeted spell that removes the Double and runs the burst from Osiris
tests.steps: Let a Double take its turn (move, Dash). On her turn, put it next to two enemies with Splinter on Command
tests.title: The Double Splinters at once, off its own turn

tests.expected: It comes into the hand like the other cards and costs 1 Thread
tests.fails: Always in hand, free, or never drawn
tests.steps: PC edition. Build a deck with Splinter on Command; play a fight
tests.title: On PC it costs 1 Thread and is drawn from the deck

tests.expected: Used in most fights, not every turn
tests.fails: Never used, or every turn (dominant) — design feedback
tests.steps: Over two fights, note the turns you used it and why
tests.title: How often Splinter on Command is used

sessions.name: Level 5 — Two Truths and Binding Falsehood: the Doubles cast her spells
sessions.setup: Level up to 5. A fight with four or more enemies.

tests.expected: Binding Falsehood and Two Truths are new; Veilstep is not there yet
tests.fails: Veilstep is granted here, or either of the two is missing
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen and the spellbook
tests.title: Level 5 grants Binding Falsehood and Two Truths, not Veilstep

tests.expected: Force damage now and at the end of its turn, then Restrained for 1 turn
tests.fails: No second damage, or no Restrained
tests.steps: Cast Binding Falsehood on an enemy (it fails the Wisdom save)
tests.title: Binding Falsehood: Force now and at turn end, then Restrained

tests.expected: Splinter, Dismiss, Reflected Seed, Reflected Falsehood (no Unveil yet)
tests.fails: The two Reflected spells are missing
tests.steps: Summon a Double and open its hotbar
tests.title: The Doubles learn Reflected Seed and Reflected Falsehood

tests.expected: Half of 3d6 Force (her slot 3) and her Seed on the target
tests.fails: Full damage, a fixed die, or no Seed
tests.steps: A Double casts Reflected Seed on an enemy
tests.title: Reflected Seed: half her Seed at her highest slot, and her Seed

tests.expected: Half of Binding Falsehood's damage; on a failed Wisdom save Restrained 1 turn
tests.fails: No save, or full damage
tests.steps: A Double casts Reflected Falsehood on an enemy
tests.title: Reflected Falsehood: half her Falsehood, save or Restrained

tests.expected: Two Doubles appear
tests.fails: One, or three
tests.steps: Cast Eidolon with a level-3 slot
tests.title: Eidolon at slot 3 summons two Doubles

tests.expected: The oldest Double goes without bursting and nobody gains Doubt; three remain
tests.fails: Four stay, or the retired Double bursts
tests.steps: With three Doubles, summon one more
tests.title: Cap 3: a fourth Double retires the oldest, quietly

sessions.name: Level 6 — Veilstep and Twice-Told: leave yourself behind, tell it twice
sessions.setup: Level up to 6. A fight with three or more enemies.

tests.expected: Veilstep and Twice-Told are new at level 6
tests.fails: Either is missing
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen and the hotbar
tests.title: Level 6 grants Veilstep and Twice-Told

tests.expected: She teleports, enemies around the landing take Force damage, a Double stands where she was
tests.fails: No Double, or it appears at the landing
tests.steps: Cast Veilstep to a spot within 18 m near enemies
tests.title: Veilstep: teleport, burst on landing, a Double where she stood

tests.expected: She and the Veilstep Double trade places
tests.fails: No Withdraw, or no swap
tests.steps: Within 2 turns of Veilstep, cast Withdraw
tests.title: Withdraw swaps her with that Double

tests.expected: *Twice-Told: Veilstep* is offered
tests.fails: It is missing
tests.steps: Cast Veilstep, then look at the hotbar
tests.title: Twice-Told: Veilstep appears after Veilstep

tests.expected: Seed of Doubt again; the second use that turn is refused
tests.fails: It recasts something else, costs an Action, or works twice in a turn
tests.steps: Cast Seed of Doubt, then Twice-Told as a Bonus Action; try a second Twice-Told the same turn
tests.title: Twice-Told recasts the last damaging card, once per turn

sessions.name: Level 7 — Tier II: every Deluded enemy seeds the next
sessions.setup: Level up to 7. A fight with five or more enemies close together.

tests.expected: Two Pillars is new; the cap is still 3 (the oldest Double retires)
tests.fails: Four Doubles stay at level 7
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen; then with three Doubles summon one more
tests.title: Level 7 grants Two Pillars and no fourth Double

tests.expected: Tier II *Two Pillars* wakes at the seventh stack
tests.fails: It wakes at another count
tests.steps: After Tier I, keep applying Doubt and watch the progress status
tests.title: Seven Doubt wake Tier II

tests.expected: That nearest enemy gains her Seed
tests.fails: No Seed, or it goes to an enemy farther than 6 m
tests.steps: At Tier II, make an enemy Deluded with another enemy within 6 m of it that has no Seed
tests.title: Two Pillars: a Deluded enemy seeds its nearest un-Seeded neighbour

tests.expected: Only the first one seeds a neighbour
tests.fails: Both seed a neighbour
tests.steps: At Tier II, make two enemies Deluded in the same turn
tests.title: Two Pillars fires once per turn

sessions.name: Level 8 — Cap 4: a fourth body on the field
sessions.setup: Level up to 8 (take the feat). A fight.

tests.expected: Four Doubles stay; a fifth retires the oldest, quietly
tests.fails: Only three stay, or five
tests.steps: Summon four Doubles (Eidolon twice at slot 3, or Veilstep and Eidolon)
tests.title: Level 8 raises the cap to 4

tests.expected: Base AC + 4
tests.fails: The layer stops at +3
tests.steps: With four Doubles, read her AC
tests.title: Four Doubles give her +4 AC

sessions.name: Level 9 — Unveil and Marionette
sessions.setup: Level up to 9. A fight with three or more enemies.

tests.expected: She and the Double trade places; the second Unveil that round is refused
tests.fails: No Unveil, no swap, or two swaps in a round
tests.steps: On a Double's turn, cast Unveil; then try Unveil with a second Double in the same round
tests.title: The Doubles learn Unveil: swap with her, once per round

tests.expected: Three Doubles appear
tests.fails: Two, or four
tests.steps: Cast Eidolon with a level-5 slot (with no Double on the field)
tests.title: Eidolon at slot 5 summons three Doubles

tests.expected: The save has Disadvantage; on a failure the enemy fights for her
tests.fails: No Disadvantage, or no control
tests.steps: Cast Marionette on an enemy with 2 Doubt
tests.title: Marionette: Disadvantage on the save at 2 Doubt

sessions.name: Level 10 — The mirror: Mirrored Self and Mirrored Spell
sessions.setup: Level up to 10. A fight with a spellcaster enemy and at least two other enemies.

tests.expected: Both cards are new at level 10
tests.fails: Either is missing
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen
tests.title: Level 10 grants Mirrored Self and Mirrored Spell

tests.expected: The spell takes two targets
tests.fails: Only one target
tests.steps: Use Mirrored Self, then cast Binding Falsehood
tests.title: Mirrored Self: her next single-target spell gains a second target

tests.expected: She gains a copy of that spell she can cast
tests.fails: No copy
tests.steps: Use Mirrored Spell; let an enemy caster cast a spell within 18 m
tests.title: Mirrored Spell copies a spell cast near her

sessions.name: Level 11 — Grand Deception: the whole field is a lie she placed
sessions.setup: Level up to 11. A fight with four or more enemies. Before casting, place two Doubles next to one enemy (within

tests.expected: Two new Doubles appear (cap 4 at this level)
tests.fails: More or fewer than the cap
tests.steps: With two Doubles on the field, cast Grand Deception
tests.title: Grand Deception fills the cap

tests.expected: That enemy gains 2 Doubt
tests.fails: It gains 0, 1 or the old flat 2 regardless of the Doubles (see L11.3)
tests.planb: Snapshot the Doubles on the card's technical status instead of UsingSpell
tests.rule: DV22 (SPEC probe B5: the count reads the Doubles before the cast)
tests.steps: Cast Grand Deception with two Doubles within 3 m of one enemy that fails its save
tests.title: An enemy beside two Doubles gains 2 Doubt on a failed save

tests.expected: No Doubt
tests.fails: It gains Doubt
tests.steps: Same cast: look at an enemy within 9 m that failed but had no Double within 3 m
tests.title: An enemy with no Double near it gains no Doubt

tests.expected: The new Doubles appear; no enemy gains Doubt from them
tests.fails: Enemies gain Doubt from the Doubles the spell just made
tests.steps: Cast Grand Deception with no Double on the field, enemies close around her
tests.title: The new Doubles don't count

tests.expected: "…gain 1 stack of Doubt for each of your Doubles that stood within 3m of them before the cast"
tests.fails: It still says 2 stacks
tests.steps: Hover Grand Deception
tests.title: The tooltip states the rule

tests.expected: Placement changes the Doubt clearly
tests.fails: Same result either way — design feedback
tests.steps: Compare a cast with Doubles placed beside enemies and one without
tests.title: Placement changes the result

sessions.name: Level 12 — Tier III: strike her and the lie explodes
sessions.setup: Level up to 12. A long fight with five or more enemies; reach Tier III (10 Doubt).

tests.expected: Aspect of Doubt and cap 5; Mirrored Self and Mirrored Spell are not granted again; five Doubles stay
tests.fails: Cap 4, or the cards arrive again
tests.steps: Look at the level-up screen; summon five Doubles
tests.title: Level 12 grants Tier III and cap 5, and nothing moves away from it

tests.expected: Tier III wakes at the tenth stack; Charisma unchanged; the status reads the new Aspect of Doubt line ("splinters by itself… reach 4m")
tests.fails: Charisma rises, or the old text
tests.steps: Note her Charisma; reach Tier III; read it again and hover the tier status
tests.title: Ten Doubt wake Tier III without a Charisma bonus

tests.expected: Both enemies take one 1d6 Psychic hit and 1 Doubt each; one damage number per enemy
tests.fails: The enemy at 3.5 m is missed, or an enemy takes two hits
tests.planb: A Tier III shapeshift rule with a damage-free Splinter
tests.steps: At Tier III, Splinter a Double with one enemy 2 m away and another 3.5 m away
tests.title: At Tier III a Splinter is one burst of 4 m

tests.expected: Two Pillars seeds the neighbour (the Deluded counts as hers); the Doubt counted on her progress status
tests.fails: No Seed for the neighbour — the Doubt is not credited to her
tests.planb: The burst applies Doubt from Osiris on each enemy within 4 m
tests.steps: At Tier III, make an enemy Deluded with a Splinter's burst, with an un-Seeded enemy within 6 m
tests.title: The burst's Doubt is hers

tests.expected: About a second later a 4 m burst where the Double stood: 1d6 Psychic and 1 Doubt to each enemy in it; the destroyer also gains its own Doubt for believing the lie
tests.fails: No burst, or it lands elsewhere
tests.planb: Read the position on the hit (AttackedBy), not on the death
tests.steps: At Tier III, leave a Double next to two enemies; let one destroy it
tests.title: A Double destroyed by an enemy bursts by itself

tests.expected: None of them bursts
tests.fails: Any of them bursts
tests.steps: At Tier III: Dismiss a Double; retire one with the cap; let an ally destroy one
tests.title: No burst when no enemy destroyed it

tests.expected: Every Double vanishes; no burst
tests.fails: A Double stays or bursts
tests.steps: At Tier III with Doubles next to enemies, let her go down
tests.title: Her death ends the Doubles without bursting

tests.expected: The reaction asks; she swaps with the nearest Double, the attack misses, that Double is destroyed without bursting, the attacker gains Doubt in her name
tests.fails: No swap, a burst, or the attacker gains no Doubt
tests.planb: Raise the Doubt through the Doubt goal with her as the cause
tests.steps: At Tier III, let an attack that would hit her land
tests.title: Ready: Which One? swaps her with the nearest Double

tests.expected: No Charisma modifier added
tests.fails: The Charisma bonus is still there
tests.steps: At Tier III, cast Seed of Doubt and read the damage breakdown
tests.title: Her Arcane spells no longer add Charisma to damage

tests.expected: Tier III wakes before the fight is decided; the bursts feel like the peak
tests.fails: It wakes after the fight is decided — design feedback
tests.steps: Note the turn Tier III wakes and how many bursts the fight has
tests.title: The peak happens in a normal fight

tests.expected: The rows of DESIGN §9.1: something at every level 1–12, no Telepathy, no Doubt passive
tests.fails: Any level differs
tests.rule: DV35 (SPEC probe B5 of the draft)
tests.steps: Claude runs `dump_progression.pl` after the sync
tests.title: The level map matches the design

tests.expected: No *Sigil*, *Shatter*, *Mirror Image*, *Distortion*, *Ethereal Chains* or *Mimic*
tests.fails: Any of them shows
tests.steps: Hover every Veilwalker card, passive and status as you play
tests.title: No old name in any Veilwalker tooltip

tests.expected: The Double is immune (Charmed, Madness, Dominated, Frightened)
tests.fails: A Double is charmed or flees
tests.steps: When an enemy casts a charm or fear effect on a Double
tests.title: Doubles ignore loss of control
